items.body_raw: אָמַר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּחֲלוֹם הַלַּיְלָה הִנֵּה אַתָּה מֵת עַל־הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתָּ וְהִיא בְּעֻלַת בָּעַל
items.answer_raw: God said to Abimelech in a dream of the night, Behold, thou art a dead man because of the woman whom thou hast taken, for she is a married woman.

items.body_raw: אָמַר אַבְרָהָם אֶל־בְּנֵי חֵת מִכְרוּ לִי קֶבֶר וְאֶקְבְּרָה מֵתִי מִלְּפָנָי
items.answer_raw: Abraham said to the Hittites, Sell me a grave, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

items.body_raw: Sell to me this cave that I may bury my dead there.
items.answer_raw: מִכְרוּ לִי אֶת־הַמְּעָרָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶקְבְּרָה אֶת־מֵתִי שָׁם

items.body_raw: His dead was buried out of his sight.
items.answer_raw: נִקְבַּר מֵתוֹ מִלְּפָנָיו

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׂאוּנִי וַהֲטִילֻנִי אֶל־הַיָּם וְיִשְׁתֹּק הַיָּם מֵעֲלֵיכֶם
items.answer_raw: And he said to them, Take me up and cast me into the sea, that the sea may grow calm (and cease) from (raging) against you.

items.body_raw: נָס
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. pf. Qal or sing. masc. ptc. Qal of נוס. He fled, or (one) fleeing

items.body_raw: סָרָה
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. fem. pf. Qal of סור, She turned aside; or fem. sing. ptc. Qal, (One) turning aside

items.body_raw: שָׁבָה
items.answer_raw: fem. sing. ptc. Qal of שׁוב. (One) returning

items.body_raw: וּבָאָה
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. fem. pf. Qal of בוא with waw consec. And she will come

items.body_raw: וְסָרוּ
items.answer_raw: 3 pl. pf. Qal of סור with waw consec. And they will turn aside

items.body_raw: אָרוּם
items.answer_raw: 1 sing. impf. Qal of רום. I will be (high, i.e.) exalted

items.body_raw: תָּשׁוּבִי
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. fem. impf. Qal of שׁוב. Thou (f.) shalt return

items.body_raw: תְּשׁוּבֶינָה
items.answer_raw: 2 or 3 pl. fem. impf. Qal of שׁוב. Ye (f.) or they (f.) shall return

items.body_raw: יָרֹם
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. jussive Qal of רום. Let him be exalted

items.body_raw: אָמוּתָה
items.answer_raw: 1 sing. cohortative Qal of מות (§ 23. 1. 2). Let me die

items.body_raw: וַיָּמָת
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. impf. Qal of מות with waw consec. And he died

items.body_raw: לָצוּד
items.answer_raw: inf. cstr. Qal of צוד, with לְ. To hunt

items.body_raw: תִּכּוֹן
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. or 3 sing. fem. impf. Niph. of כון. Thou shalt or she shall be established

items.body_raw: הֲרִימוֹתָ
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. pf. Hiph. of רום. Thou hast lifted up

items.body_raw: וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי
items.answer_raw: (scriptio defectiva for וַהֲשִׁיבוֹתִי) 1 sing. pf. Hiph. of שׁוב with waw consec. And I will turn (or bring) back

items.body_raw: יָאִיר
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. impf. Hiph. of אור. He will give light (or cause to shine)

items.body_raw: וְיָרֵם
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. jussive Hiph. of רום with simple waw. (In order) that he may lift up; or, and let him lift up

items.body_raw: אַל־תָּשֵׁב
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. or 3 sing. fem. jussive Hiph. of שׁוב, with prohibitive אַל. Do not turn away

items.body_raw: הָבִיאָה
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. emphatic imperat. Hiph. of בוא (§ 23. 2). (Cause to come, i.e.) bring

items.body_raw: נָשִׂימָה
items.answer_raw: 1 pl. cohortative Hiph. of שׂום or שׂים, or Qal of שׂים. Let us put or place

items.body_raw: יְכוֹנְנֶהָ
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. impf. Po'lel of כון with 3 sing. fem. suffix. He will establish her

items.body_raw: מוּבָא
items.answer_raw: masc. sing. ptc. Hoph. of בוא. (That which is) brought

items.body_raw: תְּמוֹתֵת
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. or 3 sing. fem. impf. Po'lel of מות. Shall slay

items.body_raw: בְּזֵעַת אַפֶּיךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם עַד שׁוּבְךָ אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה כִּי עָפָר אַתָּה וְאֶל־עָפָר תָּשׁוּב
items.answer_raw: In the sweat of thy face thou shalt eat bread till thou return to the ground; for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

items.body_raw: וַאֲנִי הִנְנִי מֵבִיא אֶת־הַמַּבּוּל מַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ לְשַׁחֵת כָּל־בָּשָׂר מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם
items.answer_raw: And on my part, behold, I am about to bring the flood, (that is), waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh from under heaven.

items.body_raw: יָדֹעַ תֵּדְעוּ כִּי אִם מְמִתִים אַתֶּם אֹתִי כִּי־דָם נָקִי אַתֶּם נֹתְנִים עֲלֵיכֶם
items.answer_raw: Know ye for certain that, if ye put me to death, it is innocent blood that ye will be bringing upon yourselves.

items.body_raw: וְלֹא מָצְאָה הַיּוֹנָה מָנוֹחַ לְכַף רַגְלָהּ וַתָּשָׁב אֶל־נֹחַ אֶל־הַתֵּבָה וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֵא אֹתָהּ אֵלָיו אֶל־הַתֵּבָה
items.answer_raw: But the dove found no resting-place for the sole of her foot, so she returned unto Noah to the ark; and he put forth his hand and took her and brought her in unto him into the ark.

items.body_raw: יהוה אֱלֹהָי תָּשָׁב־נָא נֶפֶשׁ הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה
items.answer_raw: O Yahweh, my God, I pray thee, let the soul of this child return.

items.body_raw: הנה אנכי מת והיה אלהים עמכם והשיב אתכם אל־ארץ אבותיכם
items.answer_raw: Behold, I am about to die; but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.

items.body_raw: אם־שכח תשכח את־יהוה אלהיך והלכת אחרי אלהים אחרים ועבדתם העדתי בך היום כי אבד תאבד
items.answer_raw: If thou shalt at all forget Yahweh thy God and go after other gods and serve them, I (solemnly) testify against thee this day that thou shalt assuredly perish.

items.body_raw: And they fled the way of the wilderness.
items.answer_raw: וַיָּנֻסוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּר

items.body_raw: Depart not from-after Yahweh, but (and) ye shall serve him with all your heart.
items.answer_raw: אַל־תָּסוּרוּ מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶם

items.body_raw: Arise, shine, for thy (f.) light is come.
items.answer_raw: קוּמִי אוֹרִי כִּי בָא אוֹרֵךְ

items.body_raw: And he took not from his hand (that) which he had brought.
items.answer_raw: וְלֹא לָקַח מִיָּדוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא (or הֱבִיאוֹת)

items.body_raw: I will surely-return (inf. abs.) unto thee (f.).
items.answer_raw: שׁוֹב אָשׁוּב אֵלַיִךְ

items.body_raw: And he arose in the morning and saddled his ass and went with the princes of Moab.
items.answer_raw: וַיָּקָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עִם־שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב

items.body_raw: And he called the man (dat.) and said unto him, Thou hast brought upon me and upon my kingdom a great sin.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּקְרָא לָאִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֵבֵאתָ עָלַי וְעַל־מַמְלַכְתִּי חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה

items.body_raw: And his wife said to him, If Yahweh had wished (pf.) to kill us, he would not have taken (pf.) from our hand a burnt-offering.
items.answer_raw: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ לוּ חָפֵץ יְהוָה לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ לֹא לָקַח מִיָּדֵנוּ עֹלָה

items.body_raw: And the woman went out to meet the captain of the king's host and she said, Turn aside, my lord, turn aside unto me, fear not; and he turned aside unto her to the tent.
items.answer_raw: וַתֵּצֵא הָאִשָּׁה לִקְרַאת שַׂר צְבָא הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֹּאמֶר סוּרָה אֲדֹנִי סוּרָה אֵלַי אַל־תִּירָא וַיָּסַר אֵלֶיהָ הָאֹהֱלָה

items.body_raw: לֹא תְמוּתוּן כִּי יֹדֵעַ אֱלֹהִים כִּי בְּיוֹם אֲכָלְכֶם מִן־הָעֵץ וְנִפְקְחוּ עֵינֵיכֶם
items.answer_raw: Ye shall not die, for God knoweth that in the day that ye eat of the tree, your eyes shall be opened.

items.body_raw: חֵיל גּוֹיִם יָבֹאוּ לָךְ
items.answer_raw: The wealth of the nations shall come unto thee.

items.body_raw: לֹא אֶחְפֹּץ בְּמוֹת הַמֵּת
items.answer_raw: I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth.

items.body_raw: ולמדתם את־דברי את־בניכם לדבר בם בשבתך בביתך ובלכתך בדרך ובשכבך ובקומך
items.answer_raw: And ye shall teach my words to your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

items.body_raw: Behold I am old, I know not the day of my death.
items.answer_raw: הִנֵּה זָקַנְתִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֶת־יוֹם מוֹתִי

items.body_raw: And the prophet said unto her, And thou (fem.) arise, go to thy house; when thy feet come to-the-city, then (waw cons.) the boy shall die.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הַנָּבִיא וְאַתְּ קוּמִי לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ בְּבֹא רַגְלַיִךְ הָעִירָה וּמֵת הַיָּלֶד

items.body_raw: And the men feared to return to their houses.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מִשּׁוּב אֶל־בָּתֵּיהֶם (or לָשׁוּב)

items.body_raw: וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב אֶל־יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיְמֻשֵּׁהוּ
items.answer_raw: And Jacob drew near unto Isaac his father, and he felt him.

items.body_raw: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה הַנַּעֲרָה יֹצֵאת לִקְרָאתוֹ בְּתֻפִּים
items.answer_raw: And David came to his house, and behold, the maiden was coming out to meet him with timbrels.

items.body_raw: כּוֹנְנוּ חִצָּם עַל־יֶתֶר
items.answer_raw: They have set their arrow upon the string.

items.body_raw: וַתָּבֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֵלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה שָׁמְעָה שִׁפְחָתְךָ בְּקוֹלֶךָ וָאָשִׂים נַפְשִׁי בְּכַפִּי
items.answer_raw: And the woman came to him and said, Behold, thy handmaid hath hearkened unto thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand.

items.body_raw: Plead with your mother, plead, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband.
items.answer_raw: רִיבוּ בְאִמְּכֶם רִיבוּ כִּי־הִיא לֹא אִשְׁתִּי וְאָנֹכִי לֹא אִישָׁהּ

items.body_raw: והקמתי את־בריתי אתך ובאת אל־התבה אתה ובניך ואשתך ונשי־בניך אתך
items.answer_raw: And I will establish my covenant with thee, and thou shalt enter into the ark, thou and thy sons and thy wife and thy sons' wives with thee.

items.body_raw: נָבִיא אָקִים לָהֶם מִקֶּרֶב אֲחֵיהֶם כָּמוֹךָ
items.answer_raw: A prophet will I raise up unto them from the midst of their brethren, like unto thee.

items.body_raw: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song unto their God.
items.answer_raw: אָז יָשִׁיר מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם

items.body_raw: Whosoever shall harden his heart and transgress my law shall be put to death.
items.answer_raw: כָּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְחַזֵּק אֶת־לִבּוֹ וְעָבַר אֶת־תּוֹרָתִי יוּמָת

items.body_raw: ועתה יהוה קח־נא את־נפשי ממני כי טוב מותי מחיי
items.answer_raw: And now, O Yahweh, take away my life, I pray thee, from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

items.body_raw: A living dog is better than a dead lion.
items.answer_raw: טוֹב הַכֶּלֶב הַחַי מִן־הָאַרְיֵה הַמֵּת

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אָבִיו אֶת־שְׁנֵי בָנַי תָּמִית אִם־לֹא אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֵלֶיךָ
items.answer_raw: And he said to his father, My two sons thou mayest slay, if I bring him not to thee.

items.body_raw: The queen reigned sixty-four years and died aged eighty-two: she had four sons and five daughters; her husband died in the forty-second year of her life and the twenty-fourth of her reign.
items.answer_raw: שִׁשִּׁים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה מָלְכָה הַמַּלְכָּה וַתָּמָת בַּת־שְׁמֹנִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה וְלָהּ אַרְבָּעָה בָנִים וְחָמֵשׁ בָּנוֹת וְאִישָׁהּ מֵת בְּאַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה לְחַיֶּיהָ וּבִשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה לְמָלְכָהּ

items.body_raw: מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי
items.answer_raw: Whence shall my help come?

items.body_raw: I have sworn in mine anger—ye shall not enter into my rest.
items.answer_raw: נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְאַפִּי אִם־יְבֹאוּן אֶל־מְנוּחָתִי
